answer.rationale: Roll out proven in-product activation messaging: it improved activation (+6%), week-one engagement (+11%), and 30-day retention (+1%), supporting sustainable qualified revenue without using price concessions. Do not counter with broad promotional pricing: the recovered targeted-discount result produced short-term signup and revenue gains but a 12% 30-day retention decline, which threatens long-term value. Messaging may not fully neutralize competitor-driven price churn, but it is the best validated durable response available today.
